reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Added support for configuring certificate details while populating XFCC header", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: none

consequence.statement: the capability to configure certificate details in XFCC headers is now available; existing deployments that do not use this configuration are unaffected

proposed.statement: Istio 1.24.0 adds support for configuring certificate details while populating the XFCC (X-Forwarded-Client-Cert) header.
